S1_phenology_canopy.fixed_baseline: v3 init values for all others
S1_phenology_canopy.excluded_and_reason: TB2, TM2, TO12, TO22: single-season temperature range insufficient to stably identify multiple temperature thresholds

S2_nitrogen_vegetative.primary_observations: plant nitrogen, biomass, LAI and treatment differences
S2_nitrogen_vegetative.fixed_baseline: S1 representative values for EM-FL/TRIFL, v3 init for all others
S2_nitrogen_vegetative.excluded_and_reason: RTNH4: no independent ammonium-uptake constraint; RWDTH: no direct root/width observation

S3_fruit_harvest.fixed_baseline: S1+S2 representative values, v3 init for all others
S3_fruit_harvest.excluded_and_reason: cumulative harvest is diagnostic only, does not re-enter Phi

S4_joint.active_params: approved explicit subset of S1-S3 params (at most 6), frozen before validation is opened
S4_joint.rule: select only from calibration evidence (group Phi, bounds behaviour, deterministic calibration rerun); do not inspect validation until the parameter set is frozen

expansion_rule: Each stage uses the previous stage's representative values as fixed baseline. If a param shows no stable update or only improves calibration without improving validation, it reverts to fixed. Parameter count is never expanded to compensate.
